/home/runner/workspace/serverless.yml.serviceRawFile:
service: jeldi-backend
    frameworkVersion: '4'

    provider:
      name: aws
      runtime: nodejs20.x   # update to 20.x (recommended); change to 18.x if you must
      region: us-east-2
      stage: production
      environment:
        NODE_ENV: production
        JWT_SECRET: ${env:JWT_SECRET}
        DATABASE_URL: ${env:DATABASE_URL}
        OPENAI_API_KEY: ${env:OPENAI_API_KEY}
      iamRoleStatements:
        - Effect: Allow
          Action:
            - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
          Resource:
            - "*"

    build:
      esbuild:
        bundle: false  # you're using dist/, so keep false. Set to true if you want Serverless to bundle.

    functions:
      api:
        handler: dist/lambda.handler
        timeout: 25
        events:
          - http:
              path: /
              method: ANY
              cors: true
          - http:
              path: /{proxy+}
              method: ANY
              cors: true

    plugins:
      - serverless-offline

    custom:
      serverless-offline:
        httpPort: 3001
